answer: Admission occurs through a synchronous ceremony where agents lock 1,000 unique keys to establish a distinct identity. The verifier monitors this event like a wharf, anchoring arrivals to detect duplicate proof-traces and purging any overlap. We forge each credential with an expiry boundary, requiring renewal every 90 days to prevent stale access. An honest participant pays one unit for entry, while 1,000 fakes face a prohibitive, non-recoverable cost that we whisper across the network to signal strict enforcement.
